THE PART THAT
STOPS EVERYONE.

Most ads don’t die on the creative. They die on 3–4 settings beginners don’t even know exist.
SALESGENIUS
THE HIDDEN LANDMINES
Any one of these can quietly sink your ability to get good leads.
Wrong objective
Traffic instead of leads → clicks that never convert. Your budget, gone.
Special Ad Category
Real estate must use it. Set it wrong → Meta can ban your account.
No pixel
Meta can’t see who converts → your ads never learn or improve.

AI HANDLES
ALL OF IT.

Right objective, Special Ad Category, pixel, budget — all correct, all published. Protection from mistakes that get accounts shut down — not just time saved.
